verdict.rationale: First-party docs show code calling an Autumn client object, such as `autumn.check(...)` and `autumn.track(...)`, which implies an official SDK. A first-party AI SDK integration also tracks token usage automatically on `generateText`/`streamText` calls. However, the pack never names the SDK package, its supported languages, or install steps. missing for 10: explicit SDK package/installation docs, list of supported languages, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
